reviews.x: I found most of the reviews for this item suspect. They don't describe anything about the item at all, just about the seller and the fast shipping. Seems like reviews you'd see on eBay. I get the impression that the manufacturer is reviewing themselves very highly. I didn't learn much about the product from the reviews. I encourage you to read the rest of the reviews carefully and notice that there are hardly any descriptions of the product itself.  Anyway, the hair dryer is okay. I don't notice

reviews.t: All the perfect star reviews on here are correct
reviews.x: All the perfect star reviews on here are correct. This hair dryer is awesome. Big difference in my hair! I have a lot of very fine straight hair and I'm impressed by the drying power as well as lack of heat damage. Leaves my hair sleek and frizzless-feels like I just left my salon. I like how it sits in my hand and its lighter and quieter than my old Revlon dryer. Highly recommend!

Cheapest but BEST blow dryer I have ever purchased.  It blows so much air, which makes it a bit loud.  But I don't mind the noise.  Seriously, I have put my Chi blow dryer in a drawer as backup and use this thing exclusively!  I had no idea how weak the air flow was on my Chi until this thing.  I'm never going back!

reviews.t: It worked fine until it broke and hot air doesn't blow
reviews.x: Broke after two months. Contacted manufacturer but have not heard back. It worked fine until it broke and hot air doesn't blow. Every time I use this, I felt the part where it has switches get hot easily. I was actually a little bit worried that it will blow up or something. Poor quality and no customer service from manufacturer.

reviews.t: But I am disappointed with the buttons
reviews.x: I bought this because of the high reviews. But I am disappointed with the buttons. All of the buttons are right where I hold the hair dryer, and I turn it off constantly while drying my hair. Very annoying!
purchased june 18th 2016 and january 20th 2017 no longer works in fact it shot sparks 3 feet out of blow dryer .

Best hair dryer ever! Leaves hair silky looking and very smooth! Even my 12 year old daughter commented after using my hair dryer how much she liked it. Guess I'll have to order a second one for my girls to have in their bathroom. Would definitely recommend. Great hair dryer at a decent price, WORTH the extra few dollars over your superstore/drugstore variety.

Guess I'll have to order a second one for my girls to have in their bathroom. Would definitely recommend. Great hair dryer at a decent price, WORTH the extra few dollars over your superstore/drugstore variety.

reviews.t: I love this hair dryer with the exception of one thing ...
reviews.x: I love this hair dryer with the exception of one thing -  the diffuser will not stay on.  It falls off several times every time I dry my hair, which is very frustrating.  I don't know if I just got the one diffuser that doesn't fit snugly or not.  If it weren't for this, I would have given the hair dryer 5 stars.

reviews.t: Blow Strength - Pretty great and hair dries fast
reviews.x: Weight - light enough but not too light, Blow Strength - Pretty great and hair dries fast, Noise - Some noise but not too loud, Heat - Lost of settings but the high temp doesn't burn hair. ONLY 1 ISSUE - SWITCHES are in a BAD location. When drying my hair I either bump the temp settings or end up shutting the dryer off while in use. It's quite annoying that you can't grip the handle without your hands hitting or touching the setting buttons.

This is my first blow dryer after 16 years. My hair was thinning and I had to change my hair style and stop all perms which chemically was damaging my hair. So now I have a pixie cut and needed a good blow dryer that had great temperature features and was not going to burn my hair. I also love that the cord had a Velcro strap for easy wrapping. It also has great plug with reset button.  This was a great purchase for me.

I love this blow dryer. There's 3 speeds & 3 heat settings with a cold blast button. The toggle buttons for speed/heat are situated where I won't accidentally hit them when I'm drying my hair. The cold blast button is easy to activate while drying my hair. The hottest setting is hot enough. The ions or whatever makes my hair look nice & shiny. I expect a blow dryer at this cost point to last a year - I consider that realistic. When I've spent $300 for a blow dryer then my expectations are for it

reviews.t: This product is worth the money.!
reviews.x: Great product and bought back in July of 2016. I am buying another one with the combo set which brings the diffuser and other stuff as well. I would recommend this product since it has lasted us 18 months and still going. It is used practically everyday. I have 3 females who use it constantly, so you know it works well, and hasn't died yet..

reviews.t: Not as professional grade as I would've thought. Seems ...
reviews.x: Not as professional grade as I would've thought. Seems to have the same power, heat, etc as the dryer I bought commercially from Walmart. Sorry, but not really impressed.
The dryer works ok, but the detachable air collecting mouth does not fit the dryer.

I 95% love this dryer!  Okay, in truth I would like to give it 4.5 stars, but that's not an option.  I have been shopping for several months for a new hair dryer since my old one, a Fibere by Conair Professional, has started to screech so it's only a matter of time before it completely dies.  I was looking for something else because the Fibere (2nd that I've owned) only lasts about a year.  The best feature on my old dryer was it had a 10' long power cord.  I also like the buttons to be on the s

I just received my new blow dryer and have used it a couple of times. It is absolutely amazing! It use to take me 30-40 minutes to blow dry my hair and it always ended up frizzy and half curly, it was awful! I was so shocked when I used my new one and I was done in less than 10 minutes!! And my hair was soft and smooth!! No frizzies and it was straight!! I wish I would have bought this sooner. My 13 year old has the thickest hair I've ever seen, blow drying it could easily take 45 minutes and le

Perfect for long thick hair. It used to take 20 minutes to dry my hair to damp. Now I can dry it in 5 minutest to damp. Several power blower settings and 3 temperature settings. The hair dryer itself does not heat up so I can store it imediately. I would recomend this hair dryer to friends and family.

It was OK while it lasted. Had for less than a year- had to tape the concentrator on with electrical tape for it to stay on. Tonight was mid blow dry and it just completely died- will not turn back on. Not a great piece!
Best ever! I am a professional in the beauty industry. I use blowdryers all the time and this by far is the best I’ve ever used! Dries the hair quickly and smoothly! I love it!
This hairdryer was just average. It wasn't worth the cost so I returned it. I can buy a much cheaper hairdryer that does the same thing. It did not dry my hair fast.
I'm happy with this hairdryer. It has a beautiful design and it is pleasant to the touch. I made them styling in 8 minutes. and usually I did it for 15 minutes
This is what the pros use.  Checked out the ones at my salon and almost all were using this.  Wife loves it -- dries hair much faster than store bought items.
Best hair dryer I have ever purchased!!  I have fine, straight hair.  Now I can style my hair in abut 15 minutes and it always looks full with a lot of body.
I love this hair drier. I have two other which I hate, they’re slow and it takes a while for me to dry my hair, but this is the absolute best one.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the dryer's strong airflow and fast drying, calling it the best they've owned and better than their previous dryer.
Several reviewers say it leaves hair silky, smooth, and frizz-free without heat damage.
A common complaint is that the buttons/switches are poorly placed and get bumped or turned off during use.
Some reviewers report durability problems, including the unit breaking or sparking within months and poor customer service.
A few reviewers complain that attachments like the diffuser or air-collecting mouth don't fit or stay on.
